utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Morning. Let's pick the flooring for the Level 4 fit-out today, plus the furniture delivery schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I, um, I've been looking at it. I think we go with luxury vinyl plank, from Norvik Supply.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Why not carpet tile? Everyone's doing carpet tile.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Vinyl plank's about twenty percent cheaper than the carpet tile, it's quick to replace when a section gets damaged, and Norvik can deliver in three weeks.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Norvik delivered the thing for the Level 2 floor on time, which I was surprised by, because their previous driver, you remember, he got lost twice, anyway-

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Sven.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right. Yes. Good supplier.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Is the twenty percent against the quote we have or, like, list?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Against the quote, I think. I can send it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Playing devil's advocate, three weeks is only three weeks if nothing slips.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: They've got stock.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Big picture, finance wants the floor signed off before the lease incentive ends. So three weeks matters more than anything. Mateo, you're sure about the stock?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: They confirmed Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Fine by me. Mateo, lock in the delivery slot.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Furniture schedule. Sven?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Furniture's booked for the fourteenth, but I got a call that the crew might be, hm, a day late, because of the other site-

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: How late?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: One day. Maybe two.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Two would hurt, I think? Because of the move-in date.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Which move-in date?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: The nineteenth. Staff start arriving then. I think.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It is. I checked it with HR yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Then we can't slip past the eighteenth. Sven, push them.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'll push. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Also, who's got the sample planks?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Norvik is sending three boxes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Good, I can test them.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Test what?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Whatever. Spills, mopping. I like to break stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Fine, but don't delay anything for it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I won't.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Is anyone doing the, um, budget revisions?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Me, Friday.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Thanks. Okay, that's it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: One more thing, there's a, a coffee machine thing-

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Email me.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Okay, quick one today. Aisha, the samples?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: They came Thursday. So I did a mock-up of the pantry floor, laid planks with the seams as delivered, and had the cleaners mop it wet the way they do every night. After forty-eight hours the seams had lifted and the edges had warped. The surface was fine. Just the seams.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Oh. That's, hm.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Did you use the adhesive we specified? Because we did that on the-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: The same adhesive, like we'd do on site.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I say something? I think this is a real problem. The pantry and the entrance, that's where the spills and the wet shoes are, every single day. If seams are open there, I think the planks will lift, and from what I read the warranty won't cover moisture damage on unsealed seams in wet areas.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: The warranty, is that in Norvik's sheet?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Section four. I can show you.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I didn't notice that.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Hm. Okay. What's the actual risk, Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Honestly, if it's just a nightly mop, it's a worst case. But a dishwasher leaks, or it rains for a week and everyone tracks it in, then yes.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Our pantry has a sink that's been leaking since the survey. I'm just saying.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Right. I don't want to decide this in the meeting. Let's all think about it and come back next week.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Should I hold the order?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Hold the order, yes.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Something else. Furniture. Sven?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: They confirmed the fourteenth. On time.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Good. Budget revisions, I did them. Mateo, I need your numbers for the flooring line.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: And the carpet tile quote, do we still have it?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I think so. I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Carpet doesn't lift.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Carpet's twenty percent more.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I'm just saying.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Noted. Is there anything on the move-in date?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Still the nineteenth. Nothing changed.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Good. Okay, thanks everybody.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Right. The flooring question again. With the mock-up result and what Elif found in the warranty, I think we need to look at this again before we order anything.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I called Norvik. They said they can heat-weld the seams at the factory, it's a thing they do.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Oh, that's, yes, that's what I was going to say. So, listen, we keep the vinyl plank, because it's cheaper and the delivery is fine, but we get the seams heat-sealed, and across the pantry and the entrance, the first stretch, we put ceramic tile instead of plank. That's where the water is, it takes care of it, and we don't pay for tile on the whole floor.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: How wide a stretch is enough?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Elif, you said the wet area was a few meters.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Pantry is about four meters, the entrance maybe two. A tile band across both gives margin.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: And the tile band, that's what, extra cost?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Small. I priced it, a few thousand.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Versus tile everywhere?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Way less. I think about a third of the difference.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Devil's advocate, who seals the seams where we cut planks on site?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Norvik pre-cuts to our drawings. We'd have almost no field cuts.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: And the ones we do have, I'd want a seam sealer on them. The warranty mentions it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: It's in the sheet. I'll add it to the spec.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Okay. I'm fine with that. So, we're keeping the Norvik vinyl plank, with heat-sealed seams and a ceramic tile band across the pantry and the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Placing the order today?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Place it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I see the spec before it goes?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: This reminds me of an office in, no, never mind.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Please never mind.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Sample planks, do I keep testing them?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Sealed seams, yes, test those. That's useful.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Furniture on the fourteenth, we're good. Thanks, all.
